name: TOEFL Exam
description: The Test of English as a Foreign Language, which was first held in 1964 under the name TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language), was originally a test required for admission to universities in the United States, but today it is worldwide in the United Kingdom, Netherlands, Sweden, New Zealand, Australia, Singapore and Malaysia. It is accepted by more than 9000 universities and institutions in 130 countries, including Turkey.
